_about: The MacroPad's channels, one view per sim page (PROTOCOL.md 4.7). The pad
declares every channel below and, on each turn of the knob, asks the host for
just that page's view. Each list is what that page's cells read (their TC_CH_*
references in src/headless/macropad_dash.cpp), so change the two together.
The ACC and AC EVO pages are placeholders with no view yet.
